t: These DEWALT Crossett Waterproof Safety Boots, in gunsmoke, provide robust protection and dry comfort on tough construction sites. Ideal for groundworkers and builders facing wet outdoor conditions, the durable leather upper and breathable inner lining keep feet dry throughout the working day. Safety is assured by a steel toe cap and penetration-resistant steel midsole. A wide fit design incorporates a padded collar and tongue to reduce pressure, whilst the dual-density polyurethane sole offers anti-static, shock-absorbing, and fuel oil-resistant properties with a high slip-resistance rating for secure traction on uneven surfaces.
b: Not Tested for Sole Heat Resistance
